messages.content:
Question: Why might the authors claim that although BOSSNET achieves a lower BLEU score than Mem2Seq on the SMD dataset, it still performs better in conveying necessary entity information?
Evidence:
[E1] (table, Table 13, page 14): Table 13: Example from SMD with 50% OOV. The OOV entity present in the dialog is { pittsburgh }
Values (cite as cells):
  row '': 'KB (location—day—weather) mountain view—sunday—foggy mountain view—monday—overcast pittsburgh—sunday—overcast pittsburgh—monday—warm downtown chicago—sunday—foggy downtown chicago—monday—warm' = today—monday
  row 'usr-1 sys-1 usr-2': 'KB (location—day—weather) mountain view—sunday—foggy mountain view—monday—overcast pittsburgh—sunday—overcast pittsburgh—monday—warm downtown chicago—sunday—foggy downtown chicago—monday—warm' = is the weather cloudy right now ? what city do you want the weather for ? pittsburgh
  row 'Gold': 'KB (location—day—weather) mountain view—sunday—foggy mountain view—monday—overcast pittsburgh—sunday—overcast pittsburgh—monday—warm downtown chicago—sunday—foggy downtown chicago—monday—warm' = there are no clouds in pittsburgh right now
  row 'Seq2Seq+Copy': 'KB (location—day—weather) mountain view—sunday—foggy mountain view—monday—overcast pittsburgh—sunday—overcast pittsburgh—monday—warm downtown chicago—sunday—foggy downtown chicago—monday—warm' = which is no
  row 'Seq2Seq': 'KB (location—day—weather) mountain view—sunday—foggy mountain view—monday—overcast pittsburgh—sunday—overcast pittsburgh—monday—warm downtown chicago—sunday—foggy downtown chicago—monday—warm' = it is currently raining in san francisco right now
  row 'Mem2Seq': 'KB (location—day—weather) mountain view—sunday—foggy mountain view—monday—overcast pittsburgh—sunday—overcast pittsburgh—monday—warm downtown chicago—sunday—foggy downtown chicago—monday—warm' = it will not be cloudy in in
  row 'BOSSNET': 'KB (location—day—weather) mountain view—sunday—foggy mountain view—monday—overcast pittsburgh—sunday—overcast pittsburgh—monday—warm downtown chicago—sunday—foggy downtown chicago—monday—warm' = it will be cloudy on sunday in pittsburgh

claims.text: The provided evidence does not contain a textual statement explaining the comparison between BOSSNET and Mem2Seq regarding BLEU scores and entity information, but shows an example where BOSSNET generates 'it will be cloudy on sunday in pittsburgh' containing the correct entity 'pittsburgh', whereas Mem2Seq generates 'it will not be cloudy in in'.
